related.title: ESBWR 自然循環沸水架構
related.why: 可遷移能量守恆、熱路、載荷與驗證證據；熱源、工作流體及安全邊界不同。
related.whyEn: Energy conservation, heat paths, loads and validation evidence transfer, with different heat sources, fluids and safety boundaries.
related.transfer: 可遷移能量守恆、熱路、載荷與驗證證據；熱源、工作流體及安全邊界不同。
related.transferEn: Energy conservation, heat paths, loads and validation evidence transfer, with different heat sources, fluids and safety boundaries.
related.difference: 本課針對主次迴路、被動排熱與民用電廠證據；ESBWR 自然循環沸水架構改以直接蒸汽路徑及自然循環邊界為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on primary/secondary loops, passive heat removal and civil evidence; ESBWR natural-circulation boiling-water architecture centers on direct steam paths and natural-circulation boundaries, so geometry, boundaries and product values cannot transfer unchanged.
practice: 對照壓水熱源與蒸汽發生器與沸水與直接蒸汽路，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。
把本課假想算例移到ESBWR 自然循環沸水架構，列出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以公開設計與建造驗證為起點，設計一項能區分「主次迴路、被動排熱與民用電廠證據」與「直接蒸汽路徑及自然循環邊界」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare pwr heat source/steam generators with bwr/direct steam paths and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to ESBWR natural-circulation boiling-water architecture, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from public design/build evidence and propose an observation distinguishing primary/secondary loops, passive heat removal and civil evidence from direct steam paths and natural-circulation boundaries, including uncertainty.

related.title: 福清 5 號華龍一號示範機組
related.transfer: 可遷移「年發電量與容量因數」與「儀控表決邏輯與可靠度」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；福清 5 號華龍一號示範機組的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Voting logic and reliability of instrumentation and control" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Fuqing 5 Hualong One Demonstration Unit must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦非能動安全、屏蔽馬達泵與結構模組化的定量檢核；福清 5 號華龍一號示範機組則以華龍一號首堆：能動與非能動結合的安全系統與雙層圍阻體為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on quantitative checks of passive safety, canned-motor pumps and structural modules; Fuqing 5 Hualong One Demonstration Unit centres on the first Hualong One: combined active and passive safety systems and double containment, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「熱功率、電功率與淨效率」與「熱功率、電功率與淨效率」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「屏蔽馬達主泵與惰轉」的模型移到福清 5 號華龍一號示範機組，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「儀控表決邏輯與可靠度」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Thermal power, electrical power and net efficiency" and "Thermal power, electrical power and net efficiency".
Move the model of "Canned-motor coolant pumps and coastdown" to Fuqing 5 Hualong One Demonstration Unit, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Voting logic and reliability of instrumentation and control", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「年發電量與容量因數」與「儀控表決邏輯與可靠度」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；福清 5 號華龍一號示範機組的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Voting logic and reliability of instrumentation and control" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Fuqing 5 Hualong One Demonstration Unit must be respecified.

related.title: 非能動餘熱移除系統
related.transfer: 可遷移「年發電量與容量因數」與「儀控表決邏輯與可靠度」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；非能動餘熱移除系統的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Voting logic and reliability of instrumentation and control" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Passive Residual Heat Removal Systems must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦非能動安全、屏蔽馬達泵與結構模組化的定量檢核；非能動餘熱移除系統則以不靠電力的餘熱移除：水箱的升溫時間、煙囪抽力、低壓差逆止閥與功能可靠度為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on quantitative checks of passive safety, canned-motor pumps and structural modules; Passive Residual Heat Removal Systems centres on residual-heat removal without electricity: tank heat-up time, stack draft, low-differential check valves and functional reliability, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「熱功率、電功率與淨效率」與「衰變熱與停機後冷卻」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「屏蔽馬達主泵與惰轉」的模型移到非能動餘熱移除系統，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「移熱容量與需求的餘裕」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Thermal power, electrical power and net efficiency" and "Decay heat and post-shutdown cooling".
Move the model of "Canned-motor coolant pumps and coastdown" to Passive Residual Heat Removal Systems, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Margin of heat-removal capacity over demand", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「年發電量與容量因數」與「儀控表決邏輯與可靠度」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；非能動餘熱移除系統的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Voting logic and reliability of instrumentation and control" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Passive Residual Heat Removal Systems must be respecified.
